seedYearRange.title: Seed year range
seedYearRange.description: The inclusive year range the database is expected to have panchangam data seeded for. Drives the valid year bound on /panchangam/month and /panchangam/year.

defaultLocation.title: Default location
defaultLocation.description: The location code served when a request omits ?location=.

maxGenerateSpan.title: Max generation span (days)
maxGenerateSpan.description: Shared cap on the size of a live-generation date range, for the panchangam and kollavarsham /generate endpoints.

maxEventGenerateSpan.title: Max event generation span (years)
maxEventGenerateSpan.description: Cap on the size of a Santhigiri event occurrence-generation year range.

eventCutoffs.title: Event day-attribution cutoffs
eventCutoffs.description: The 7.5 Nazhika rule for last-occurrence events, and the 3-hour cutoff for nakshatra-transition-series events.

astronomyEpsilons.title: Astronomy epsilons
astronomyEpsilons.description: Small boundary-tie epsilons used by the discrete-transition search and the Kollavarsham raasi calculation. Fragile, correctness-critical internals — change with caution.

nakshatraStepDays.title: Nakshatra transition step size
nakshatraStepDays.description: Skyfield search step (days) used to find Nakshatra transitions, with optional per-year overrides (e.g. a year that needs a coarser step). Fragile, correctness-critical — change with caution.
nakshatraStepDays.defaultStepMustBeNumber: Default step must be a number.
nakshatraStepDays.overrideStepMustBeNumber: The override step for {{year}} must be a number.
